tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the DABUGS catalog (women's tops, skirts, jeans, shorts…). Returns handle, title, category, price/finalPrice in VND, colors, sizes, inStock, url, image.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product: every variant (sku, color, size, price, finalPrice, inStock), images, description and size chart (cm).

tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.description: Validate items, stock, address and compute the exact total (auto vouchers + free shipping). Returns a summary and a quote_token valid 30 minutes. Does NOT create an order.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Create the real order from a quote_token. Call ONLY after the user has seen the prepare_checkout summary and explicitly confirmed. Returns order id + payment instructions (QR / payment link for bank / vnpay).

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status, payment state and tracking number of an order. Requires the order id and the recipient phone number used for the order.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Build a dabugs.com link that fills the user's cart with these SKUs and opens checkout, so the user can finish the purchase in their own browser (works on phones).

tools.name: find_address
tools.description: Look up official Vietnamese province and ward/commune names (2-level system since 07/2025, same list the courier uses). Without province: list the 34 provinces. With province (+ optional query): list/search its wards. Use it when prepare_checkout returns unknown_province / unknown_ward.

tools.name: get_store_policies
tools.description: Shipping, returns/exchange, payment methods, contact information and the promotions running right now (bundle sets, buy-more discounts, free gift thresholds).
